title: HELIX Bridge: Banner → CourseSection
saas_vs_onprem: Banner SaaS (Ellucian Cloud) uses the same underlying Oracle schema. Access methods differ: on-prem uses direct Oracle SQL; SaaS uses Ellucian Data Connect (EDC), Ethos Integration API, or Banner Integration API (BIA). Table/column names are identical across both deployment models.

source_tables.description: Section base. CRN, term, subject, course, section number, status, campus, capacity, enrollment counts. One row per section per term.
Section meeting times. Days, start/end times, building, room. One row per meeting pattern per section.
Instructor assignment. Links instructors to sections with role (primary, secondary). One row per instructor per section.
Cross-list group. Links sections that share a physical meeting (cross-listed courses). SSRXLST_XLST_GROUP groups them.
Campus validation. Campus codes and descriptions.
Schedule type validation. Lecture, lab, seminar, independent study, etc.
